identification: Framed John Tallis / J. Rapkin steel-engraved map 'Van Diemen's Island or Tasmania', c1851 (Tallis Illustrated Atlas), hand-coloured outline, Greek key and floral border, vignettes of Hobart Town, Government House and thylacine. Design matches the original Tallis; photos cannot rule out a later facsimile. Heavy brown foxing and stains.

searches_tried: pipeline/comps.py: 'tallis map tasmania', 'van diemen's land map', 'tasmania map engraving', 'rapkin map'; work/comps.py same four.
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: 'Tallis map Van Diemen's Island Tasmania' and 'Tallis Tasmania map framed' (last 12 months, check size and whether described original). Also Leski Auctions realized prices and LiveAuctioneers/Invaluable for 'Tallis Van Diemen's Island or Tasmania'; Gowans/Leski for Tasmanian map prints; check for facsimile/reproduction listings of the same map.
viewing_check: Check the printed imprint at the foot (John Tallis & Co, J. Rapkin) and the plate/paper: genuine c1851 has plate mark, laid/wove paper with age toning and no dot pattern under a loupe (reproductions show halftone dots). Back of frame for age, and check stain severity and whether the paper is brittle. Measure sheet size.
rate_note: All prices read as AUD at 1.0 (Australian databases; the eBay AU Terapeak record is AU).
